from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single expense line item extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant company name as named in the filing")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the document (e.g. 'General and administrative')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the figure covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_records: list[ExpenseRecord]
